messages:
leo: heads-up: deploybot tried to unpin runtime 2.20 -> 2.21 in ap-south during the midnight window. I detected increased embed size variance and pinned back to 2.20. tagging @mira and @sre-jo

deploybot: Automatic action: pinned runtime 2.20 in region ap-south. reason=embed-size-variance. cmd=/deploybot pin runtime ap-south 2.20 --reason embed-size-variance

mira: Any customer impact? 5xxs or SDK parse fails?

sre-jo: No 5xx. Small uptick in SDK parse warnings where consumers assert exact length. Example log: WARN embed_check: expected=1536 got=1600 client=sdk-3.5 req=xyz

sdk-ryan: Runtime 2.21 introduced alignment padding for certain kernels (adds trailing zeros). SDK assumed trim behavior. We can do either runtime hotfix to stop padding, or ship SDK 3.5.1 tolerant deserializer, or add an edge-trim adapter.

leo: Immediate plan: hold auto-unpin for 8h (ops-bot?), keep pin 2.20 in ap-south, and prepare two parallel fixes: small runtime patch (if low-risk) and SDK patch. Also prepare support advisory.

ops-bot: Action: auto-unpin hold placed for 8h. Notifying release-ops and infra-oncall.

mira: Prefer SDK patch + edge adapter first to avoid kernel touch. Add canary plan: staging -> 5% ap-south -> full. SRE to add embed_length_distribution card and alert if new length >0.2%

sre-jo: Will add dashboard and a temporary alert. Also draft rollback steps: /deploybot pin runtime ap-south 2.20, disable canary, revert config. Owner=leo.

sdk-ryan: I'll prepare 3.5.1 with tolerant deserializer and release notes. ETA ~2.5h. Will open PR and link here.

leo: Decision summary: 1) hold auto-unpin 8h, 2) keep pin 2.20, 3) sdk to patch 3.5.1, 4) ingress trim adapter if needed, 5) SRE + QA run canary checks. Update this thread with PR and canary start.

mira: Thanks — please update when PR is up and when canary starts.

sre-jo: Posting initial dashboard snapshot once metrics are in.

leo: filing follow-up task to add embedding-length sanity in CI. Closing loop after canary. :white_check_mark:
